newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones ended at 6,303.71 points, down 98.81 points. PLDT's ADR rose slightly by $0 3/8 at $58 1/4.
* On Thursday, the peso closed at 26.297 to the dollar from 26.283.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,129.11, down 31.65.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was at 11.0625 from 12 pct.
* Stock brokerage house Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phils) Inc advise investors to start accumulating near the 3,100 level.

"The market may move sideways in the near term presenting buying opportunities as the fundamentals of the country remain strong. Sentiment is building up in the U.S. over a possible recession next year. Accumulators can ride the move of portfolio investments towards emerging markets," the brokerage firm said in its daily market outlook.
* The Energy Regulatory Board is expected to announce the fifth round of fuel price adjustments today with cuts in fuel oil and gasoline. (BUSINESSWORLD)

* The Makati Business Club and the Management Association of the Philippines (MAP) expressed optimism that the economy will grow by 7 to 7.5 percent next year and that inflation could be contained at 6.5 to seven percent next year. (BULLETIN)

* Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co is now in alliance with the Tokai Bank of Japan as the Monetary Board approved the latter's 30 percent equity stake in Global Business Bank, a newly formed commercial bank. (CHRONICLE)
* Property developer Kuok Philippine Properties Inc has signed a deed of exchange of shares with Gipsey Ltd, a British Virgin Island firm. (TIMES JOURNAL)
